historical_record.description: The Art Commission approved the preliminary sketches for the Hall of Flowers, Golden Gate Park, designed by Appleton and Wolfard, Architects.
The Art Commission approved the Phase II and III plans for the Helen Crocker Russell Library at the Hall of Flowers.

The Recreation and Park Commission engaged Appleton & Wolfard, architects, for preliminary plans and cost estimates for a proposed Exhibit and Exposition Building in Golden Gate Park, for a fee of up to $12,600.

The Recreation and Park Commission authorized Appleton & Wolfard, architects, to go ahead with preliminary plans and cost estimates for the Exhibit and Exposition Building on the site it had just chosen, the southeast part of the Strybing Arboretum.
